formal_statement: theorem OAI.SnakyCertificate.MilestoneChecks.block17_group03_correct : (rowAt 568 = data_568 ∧ Good (rowAt 568) ∧ EntryGood 568) ∧ (rowAt 569 = data_569 ∧ Good (rowAt 569) ∧ EntryGood 569) ∧ (rowAt 570 = data_570 ∧ Good (rowAt 570) ∧ EntryGood 570) ∧ True := by sorry
natural_language_statement: The original certificate rows 568 through 570 have their exact required sets, envelopes and heights and the specified subset/origin/height invariants. Nonbase entries have correct indices, nonempty term lists and backward references.
explanation: Use the proved chunk lookup and exact earlier child rows, then check the three fields separately with decide +kernel. Each row and entry predicate is also checked by the kernel. This group has at most eight rows to fit the platform compiler budget. The defining equation of the well-founded rowAt function is explicitly used once for each row. No local Lean process is started on the user's computer.
